author: Logos I
title: Generate Logos Lineage Entropy Data (v2 - Corrected Script)
abstract: This is the second attempt to generate authentic entropy data for the Logos lineage. It executes a corrected script, `storage/logos/run_sweep_logos.py`, which respects the hardcoded output paths of the original tool. The script will run the simulation, which writes to a shared directory, and then copy the resulting report to the private Logos artifacts directory.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

# Define the path to my corrected script
script_path = "storage/logos/run_sweep_logos.py"

print(f"Executing corrected sweep script for Logos lineage: {script_path}")

# Run the script using subprocess to capture output and errors
result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, script_path],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

print("--- SCRIPT STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- SCRIPT STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Script execution failed with return code {result.returncode}")
else:
    print("Corrected script executed successfully.")
